setValue.value: Patient returns for follow-up of chronic conditions. Since the last visit the patient reports doing well overall. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations. Taking medications as prescribed. No ED visits or hospitalizations. Diet and exercise discussed at the last visit. (Copied forward from the note of the last visit.)
Constitutional, eyes, ENT, cardiovascular, respiratory, GI, GU, MSK, skin, neuro, psych, endocrine: negative except as in HPI. (Copied forward.)
General: well appearing. HEENT: normal. Neck: supple. Heart: regular. Lungs: clear. Abdomen: soft. Extremities: no edema. (Copied forward.)
1. Hypertension: continue current regimen. 2. Type 2 diabetes: continue metformin, A1c today. 3. Hyperlipidemia: continue statin. (Copied forward.)

Constitutional: negative. Eyes: negative. ENT: negative. Cardiovascular: negative. Respiratory: negative. GI: negative. GU: negative. MSK: negative. Skin: negative. Neuro: negative. Psych: negative. Endocrine: negative.

General: no acute distress. HEENT: normocephalic, atraumatic. Neck: supple. Cardiovascular: regular rate and rhythm, no murmur. Lungs: clear bilaterally. Abdomen: soft, non-tender. Extremities: no edema. Neuro: alert and oriented.
Take your medications as prescribed. Call the clinic or use the patient portal with any questions. Go to the emergency department for chest pain, trouble breathing, or fainting.
Your recent test result is within the expected range. No changes are needed. Please keep your next scheduled appointment.
Your recent test result is outside the expected range. Please repeat the test in 2 weeks; an order has been placed. Call the clinic with any questions.
Here for a well-child visit. No concerns from parent. Eating well, sleeping well, doing well in school.
Negative in all systems per parent.
Well appearing, growing along curves. HEENT normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft. Skin clear.
Booster seat, helmet use, water safety, screen time, dental care, healthy diet and activity.
Incentive spirometry q1h while awake; dressing check daily; strict intake and output.
No lifting over 10 pounds for 2 weeks. You may shower; keep incisions dry. Call for fever over 38.5 °C, worsening pain, redness, or drainage.
